standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images on a basis
standard_prerequisites.use: H^i(Rf_*K) as sheafification of V |-> H^i(f^{-1}(V),K).

core_obligations: Part (1): H^i(Rf_*K) is the sheaf associated to V |-> H^i(f^{-1}(V),K) = H^i(V, Rf_*K); the assumptions on B give vanishing of negative cohomology sheaves, hence H^i(f^{-1}V,K) = 0 for i < 0 and all opens V, and V |-> H^0(f^{-1}V,K) is a sheaf (proof lines 11145-11152).
Part (2): apply (1) to the complex R SheafHom(K,L) using Lemma section-RHom-over-U to translate Ext groups and Hom presheaves (proof lines 11153-11157).
proof_roadmap: Describe the higher direct images on the basis.
Apply part (1) to the internal hom complex.
difficulty_reason: Part (1) computes the sheaves H^i(Rf_*K) through the description of higher direct images on a basis; part (2) applies (1) to the internal hom complex R SheafHom(K,L) with the section-RHom-over-U translation.
